metas.name: The Boondock Saints
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved The Departed

Two Irish Catholic brothers become vigilantes in order to try to wipe out Boston's criminal underworld in the name of God.

metas.name: Once Bitten
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Death Becomes Her

A vampire Countess needs to drink the blood of a virgin in order to keep her eternal beauty. It seems that all is hopeless, until she bumps into Mark Kendall.

metas.name: Alien: Covenant
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Alien

The crew of a colony ship, bound for a remote planet, discover an uncharted paradise with a threat beyond their imagination, and must attempt a harrowing escape.

metas.name: The Giant Mechanical Man
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved The Lobster

An offbeat romantic comedy about a silver-painted street performer and the soft spoken zoo worker who falls for him.

metas.name: Stonehearst Asylum
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Twelve Monkeys

When Dr Edward Newgate arrives at the asylum to begin his residency, he finds the Dr in charge has adopted unusual methods of treatment, methods that give his patients a lot of freedom. But cracks appear in the hospital's cheerful...

metas.name: Star Trek Beyond
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Dune: Part Two

The crew of the USS Enterprise explores the furthest reaches of uncharted space, where they encounter a new ruthless enemy, who puts them, and everything the Federation stands for, to the test.

metas.name: House of 1000 Corpses
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved The Exorcist

Two young couples traveling across the backwoods of Texas searching for urban legends of murder end up as prisoners of a bizarre and sadistic backwater family of serial killers.

metas.name: The Andromeda Strain
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Contagion

Top scientists work feverishly in a secret, state-of-the-art laboratory to discover what killed the citizens of a small town and how the deadly contagion can be stopped.

metas.name: State of Grace
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved The Departed

An undercover officer rejoins Irish mob pals in Hell's Kitchen.

metas.name: My Best Friend Is a Vampire
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Death Becomes Her

After a sexual encounter with a beautiful client, a teenage delivery boy finds himself being turned into a vampire.

metas.name: Prometheus
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Alien

Following clues to the origin of mankind, a team finds a structure on a distant moon, but they soon realize they are not alone.

metas.name: Just Before I Go
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved The Lobster

On the verge of giving up on life, a guy travels to his hometown to make amends.

metas.name: A Scanner Darkly
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Twelve Monkeys

An undercover cop in a not-too-distant future becomes involved with a dangerous new drug and begins to lose his own identity as a result.

metas.name: X-Men: Days of Future Past
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Dune: Part Two

The X-Men send Wolverine to the past in a desperate effort to change history and prevent an event that results in doom for both humans and mutants.

metas.name: The Believers
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved The Exorcist

Cal Jamison, a police psychologist, is forced to deal with a series of ritualistic murders and a malevolent cult.

metas.name: The Core
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Contagion

The only way to save Earth from catastrophe is to drill down to the core and set it spinning again.

metas.name: The Corruptor
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved The Departed

With the aid from a New York City policeman, a top immigrant cop tries to stop drug-trafficking and corruption by immigrant Chinese Triads, but things get complicated when the Triads try to bribe the policeman.

metas.name: Beetlejuice Beetlejuice
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Death Becomes Her

After a family tragedy, three generations of the Deetz family return home to Winter River. Still haunted by Beetlejuice, Lydia's life is turned upside down when her teenage daughter, Astrid, accidentally opens the portal to the Af...

metas.name: Pandorum
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Alien

Two crew members of a spaceship wake up from hypersleep to discover that all their colleagues are missing. Despite this, it appears that they are not alone.

metas.name: Mumford
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved The Lobster

In the small town of Mumford, a psychologist of the same name moves in and quickly becomes very popular, despite a questionable past.

metas.name: The Island
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Twelve Monkeys

In 2019, a mercenary pursues a man and woman who escaped a research facility after learning their true fate.

metas.name: The Time Machine
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Dune: Part Two

Hoping to alter the events of the past, a 19th century inventor instead travels 800,000 years into the future, where he finds humankind divided into two warring races.

metas.name: Hellraiser
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved The Exorcist

A woman discovers the newly resurrected, partially formed, body of her brother-in-law and lover. She starts killing for him to revitalize his body and escape the demonic beings that are pursuing him after he escaped their underworld.

metas.name: Outbreak
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Contagion

A team of Army doctors struggle to find a cure for the deadly Motaba virus that was transported from Africa to North America by a white-headed Capuchin monkey and is now spreading quickly throughout a small California town.

metas.name: Menace II Society
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved The Departed

This urban nightmare chronicles several days after the graduation of young street hustler as he attempts to escape the rigors and temptations of the Watts, California ghetto in search of a better life.

metas.name: Dracula: Dead and Loving It
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Death Becomes Her

Mel Brooks' parody of the classic vampire story and its famous film adaptations.

metas.name: Screamers
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Alien

A military commander stationed off planet during an interplanetary war travels through the devastated landscape to negotiate a peace treaty, but discovers that the primitive robots they built to kill enemy combatants have gained s...

metas.name: Blind
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved The Lobster

A novelist blinded in a car crash which killed his wife rediscovers his passion for both life and writing when he embarks on an affair with the neglected wife of an indicted businessman.

metas.name: Open Grave
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Twelve Monkeys

A man wakes up with no memory in a pit full of dead bodies in the wilderness and must determine if the murderer is one of the strangers who rescued him, or if he himself is the killer.

metas.name: The Hunger Games: The Ballad of Songbirds & Snakes
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Dune: Part Two

Coriolanus Snow mentors and develops feelings for the female District 12 tribute during the 10th Hunger Games.

metas.name: A Nightmare on Elm Street
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved The Exorcist

Teenager Nancy Thompson must uncover the dark truth concealed by her parents after she and her friends become targets of the spirit of a serial killer with a bladed glove in their dreams, in which if they die, it kills them in rea...

metas.name: Rise of the Planet of the Apes
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Contagion

A substance designed to help the brain repair itself gives advanced intelligence to a chimpanzee who leads an ape uprising.

metas.name: Rise of the Footsoldier
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved The Departed

The life of career criminal Carlton Leach.

metas.name: The Fearless Vampire Killers
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Death Becomes Her

A noted professor and his dim-witted apprentice fall prey to their inquiring vampires, while on the trail of the ominous damsel in distress.

metas.name: Pitch Black
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Alien

A transport ship crashes and leaves its crew stranded on a desert planet inhabited by bloodthirsty creatures that come out during an eclipse.

metas.name: Modern Romance
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved The Lobster

Albert Brooks directs himself as a successful film editor with far too many issues that affects the relationship between him and his remarkably patient girlfriend.

metas.name: I Am Legend
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Twelve Monkeys

Years after a plague kills most of humanity and transforms the rest into monsters, the sole survivor in New York City struggles valiantly to find a cure.

metas.name: And Now the Screaming Starts!
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved The Exorcist

England, 1795: the young Catherine has just married Charles Fengriffen and moves into his castle. She becomes the victim of a curse that was laid on the family long ago. On her wedding night she is raped by a ghost and gets pregnant.

metas.name: Terminator Genisys
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Contagion

When John Connor, leader of the human resistance, sends Sgt. Kyle Reese back to 1984 to protect Sarah Connor and safeguard the future, an unexpected turn of events creates a fractured timeline.

metas.name: Lucky Number Slevin
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved The Departed

A case of mistaken identity lands Slevin into the middle of a war being plotted by two of the city's rival crime bosses. Under constant surveillance by Detective Brikowski and assassin Goodkat, he must get them before they get him.

metas.name: Tales of Terror
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Death Becomes Her

Three tales of terror involve a grieving widower and the daughter he abandoned; a drunkard and his wife's black cat; and a hypnotist who prolongs the moment of a man's death.

metas.name: Alien³
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Alien

Returning from LV-426, Ellen Ripley crash-lands on the maximum-security prison Fiorina 161, where she discovers that she has unwittingly brought along an unwelcome visitor.

metas.name: Die Alone
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Twelve Monkeys

Tells the story of a young man who has amnesia. He bands together with a rugged survivalist in a zombie-like outbreak to find his girlfriend.

metas.name: The Serpent and the Rainbow
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved The Exorcist

An anthropologist goes to Haiti to research a drug that makes someone appear dead by suspending all vital signs.

metas.name: Maze Runner: The Death Cure
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Contagion

In a desperate attempt to save their friends, the Gladers try to infiltrate a fortified city and make it out alive.

metas.name: A History of Violence
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved The Departed

A mild-mannered man becomes a local hero through an act of violence, which sets off repercussions that will shake his family to its very core.

metas.name: Dark Shadows
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Death Becomes Her

An imprisoned vampire, Barnabas Collins, is set free and returns to his ancestral home, where his dysfunctional descendants are in need of his protection.

metas.name: Serenity
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Alien

The crew of the ship Serenity try to evade an assassin sent to recapture telepath River.

metas.name: The Bay
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Twelve Monkeys

Chaos breaks out in a small Maryland town after an ecological disaster occurs.

metas.name: Hellbound: Hellraiser II
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved The Exorcist

Kirsty is brought to an institution after the horrible events of Hellraiser (1987), where the occult-obsessive head doctor resurrects Julia and unleashes the Cenobites and their demonic underworld.

metas.name: Sleep Dealer
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Contagion

The near future. Like tomorrow. In a world marked by closed borders, corporate warriors, and a global computer network, three strangers risk their lives to connect, break through the barriers of technology, and unseal their fates.

metas.name: Scarface
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved The Departed

In the 1980s, a determined criminal-minded Cuban immigrant becomes the biggest drug smuggler in Miami, and is eventually undone by his own drug addiction.

metas.name: Twice-Told Tales
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Death Becomes Her

Three horror stories based on the writings of Nathaniel Hawthorne. In the first story titled "Dr. Heidegger's Experiment", Heidegger attempts to restore the youth of himself, his fiancee and his best friend. In "Rappaccini's Daugh...

metas.name: Sunshine
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Alien

A team of international astronauts is sent on a dangerous mission to reignite the dying Sun with a nuclear fission bomb in 2057.

metas.name: Dark City
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Twelve Monkeys

A man struggles with memories of his past, which include a wife he cannot remember and a nightmarish world no one else ever seems to wake up from.

metas.name: Mother's Day
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved The Exorcist

The sadistic members of a villainous family return to their childhood home to terrorize the new home owners and their guests.

metas.name: Light of My Life
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Contagion

A father and his child journey through the outskirts of society a decade after a pandemic has wiped out half the world's population. As the father struggles to protect his child, their bond and the character of humanity are tested.

metas.name: Gotti
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved The Departed

John Gotti rises to head the powerful Gambino crime family before being convicted in 1992 of racketeering and murder.

metas.name: The Little Shop of Horrors
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Death Becomes Her

A clumsy young man working at an impoverished flower shop discovers that the strange plant he has been nurturing has an insatiable appetite for blood, forcing him to kill to feed it.

metas.name: Iron Lung
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Alien

In a post-apocalyptic future after "The Quiet Rapture" event, a convict explores a blood ocean on a desolate moon using a submarine called the "Iron Lung" to search for missing stars/planets.
